title: Nocturnal Wildlife Activity Clock
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trailcam:detection
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as detections by label hour
| sort label hour
description: Maps when each species is active through the night, revealing the hidden schedule of your local nocturnal wildlife.
value: Different animals own different hours; an activity clock per species is a fascinating, genuinely scientific view of your patch.
implementation: Ingest trail-cam detections; review activity by species and hour.
visualization: Heatmap of wildlife activity by species and hour.
grandmaExplanation: It shows what time of night each animal is active, revealing the secret schedule of your local wildlife.
